Headquarters: Remote - MX

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Manager, Marketing Data and Technology to own the reliability of the data and technical processes that support Oportun’s marketing ecosystem. You’ll ensure marketing data is accurate, complete, consistent, and available across platforms and internal systems to support campaign execution, measurement, attribution, and growth.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You’ll serve as the primary owner for assigned MarTech systems, integrations, and tracking processes, working independently to identify issues, recommend solutions, and drive improvements through implementation. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Analytics, Product, Engineering, and external vendors to keep systems reliable and data flowing correctly.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You’ll own marketing data quality across assigned platforms and internal databases, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely delivery.

• You’ll build and maintain validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting processes to identify missing records, discrepancies, and failed data flows.

• You’ll investigate root causes of data and integration issues and drive solutions through implementation and ongoing monitoring.

• You’ll manage website tagging and tracking, including Google Analytics, tag management configurations, pixels, and event implementations.

• You’ll configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot APIs, webhooks, and data integrations between marketing vendors and internal systems.

• You’ll use Python or SQL to query, validate, transform, and reconcile data and automate recurring operational tasks.

• You’ll manage and troubleshoot assigned MarTech tools and configurations to support reliable data collection, audience activation, and reporting.

• You’ll establish and maintain consistent UTM parameters, campaign naming conventions, and tracking standards to improve attribution and measurement.

• You’ll identify data gaps, process weaknesses, and opportunities to improve tracking, integrations, automation, and operational efficiency.

• You’ll document data flows, tracking definitions, configurations, validation procedures, and troubleshooting processes to support team continuity and reliable operations.

• You’ll coordinate with cross-functional partners and vendors on requirements, testing, releases, issue resolution, priorities, and risks.

• You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve data validation, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational efficiency.

• You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a hands-on technical marketer who enjoys solving data and systems problems and taking ownership from issue identification through resolution. You’re comfortable working independently, but you also know when to bring in the right partners.

You’re detail-oriented, proactive, and process-minded. You care about data quality, clear documentation, and reliable systems, and you consistently look for ways to make technical workflows more scalable and efficient.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

• 5+ years of relevant experience in marketing technology, marketing data operations, data engineering, marketing analytics, or a similar technical role.

• Proficiency in Python or SQL, with the ability to independently write, troubleshoot, and maintain code for data validation, transformation, or automation.

• Hands-on experience managing website tagging and tracking, including Google Analytics and a tag management platform such as Google Tag Manager or Tealium.

• Experience configuring, testing, and troubleshooting REST APIs, webhooks, and data integrations.

• Experience reconciling data across systems, implementing quality checks, and resolving underlying data issues.

• Demonstrated ability to serve as the primary owner of assigned systems and processes in a small team environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, recommend practical solutions, and follow through on implementation.

• Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and project management skills.

• Ability to work autonomously across teams, vendors, and time zones while managing competing priorities.

Nice to Have

• Experience establishing or maintaining website and digital tagging frameworks and marketing attribution data.

• Experience with Databricks, customer data platforms, Amplitude, Iterable, or similar marketing and analytics tools.

• Experience with scripting, workflow automation, scheduled data jobs, or monitoring tools.

• Experience in financial services or another environment involving sensitive customer data.

• Familiarity with data privacy, access controls, and governance requirements.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, or automation.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you 

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

Mexico Benefits:

Medical Insurance 
Savings Fund
Life Insurance
Internet and Electricity Allowance
Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers   #LI-REMOTE #LI-VR1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Hi,
This is Neha Jain from Aquilasys Inc.
I am reaching out regarding an immediate, high-visibility opportunity for a Business Data Analyst (Capital Markets, QA & Data Engineering) supporting our enterprise fintech and asset management client based in Hyderabad.
We currently have open positions for experienced professionals (8+ years) who blend capital markets trading domain knowledge with deep data analytics, database development, and QA testing frameworks.
Position Details
Role: Business Data Analyst Capital Markets & Quality Assurance
Location: Hyderabad
Work Setup: Hybrid Model (3 Days Office / 2 Days Work from Home)
Shift Window: 01:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST (EMEA / UK Business Window Overlap)
Experience Required: Minimum 8+ Years of relevant professional experience
Domain Focus: Fintech, Asset Management, Capital Markets (Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives Trading), Billing & Payments, Issuer Communications
Technical Environment: SQL Developer, PostgreSQL, Python / JavaScript scripting, Database Software, QA Test Frameworks, Agile/Scrum
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
Position Overview
In this specialized analytical role, you will bridge the gap between capital markets business operations, financial data architectures, and quality engineering teams. You will work directly with business stakeholders across billing, payment systems, and trade execution to evaluate data integrity, validate transactional accuracy, and enhance testing frameworks. You will leverage SQL Developer, PostgreSQL, and Python/JavaScript scripting to extract, model, and reconcile complex trading datasets. Additionally, you will lead calibration sessions between Delivery and QA squads, verify global market data feeds, and conduct targeted quality briefings for financial advisors to drive systemic service improvements.
Key Responsibilities
Business & Billing Data Validation: Partner directly with business users to audit billing mechanisms, payment reconciliation schedules, and fee structures, establishing rigorous quality assurance data checks.
Capital Markets Data & Functional Testing: Perform end-to-end data analysis, functional testing, and quality reporting across front-to-back trading flows for Equities, Fixed Income, and Derivatives.
Database Querying & Analysis: Develop and optimize complex queries using SQL Developer and PostgreSQL to perform forensic data reconciliation, validate trade records, and isolate data breaks.
Scripting & Test Framework Improvement: Utilize Python or JavaScript scripting to automate routine data validation tasks, build test scenarios, and refine functional testing frameworks within Agile workflows.
Calibration & Delivery Alignment: Lead and facilitate structured calibration sessions in sync with Delivery and QA teams to establish defect prevention benchmarks and clarify acceptance criteria.
Advisor Briefings & Quality Governance: Develop and lead briefings for targeted groups of advisors, addressing service quality deficiencies, transaction break patterns, and continuous improvement opportunities.
Market Data Verification: Validate reference data, pricing feeds, and corporate action inputs from global market data providers, ensuring downstream feed integrity across analytical engines.
Must-Have:
Domain Depth: Solid working understanding of Capital Markets, Asset Management, and Trading Mechanics (specifically Equities, Fixed Income, and Derivatives).
Database & Technical Mastery:
Hands-on proficiency with SQL Developer and PostgreSQL for querying, data profiling, and schema validation.
Practical scripting experience with Python or JavaScript for data parsing, validation, or test automation.
QA & Methodology Foundations: Proven experience in functional testing, quality reporting, test framework enhancement, and Agile/Scrum approaches.
Calibration & Communication: Strong background running cross-functional calibration sessions between business and engineering teams, paired with excellent executive presentation and briefing skills.
Preferred / Desired:
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, or related field.
Prior experience analyzing billing platforms, clearing/settlement engines, or institutional issuer communications.
Familiarity with market data feeds (Bloomberg, Refinitiv/LSEG) and API-driven data workflows.
 
If you have 8+ years of experience combining Capital Markets with SQL/PostgreSQL, Python/JavaScript, and QA analysis and are open to this hybrid role in Hyderabad, please reply with your updated resume, current location, current fixed CTC/rate, expected CTC/rate, and confirmed official notice period / earliest joining date.

Kitopi is a creator of magical food experiences—we discover, create, and curate homegrown brands from the region, for the region.

With a purpose to satisfy the world’s appetite to create joy, Kitopi owns and operates a diverse portfolio of over 200+ brands. These brands are either created, discovered, or curated with their customers in mind.

Launched in Dubai, UAE, in January 2018, Kitopi has grown to become one of the greatest success stories in the food tech space. By July 2021, Kitopi achieved Unicorn status, becoming the fastest company in the MENA region to reach this milestone.

Kitopi’s growth has been fueled by its innovative and scalable software solutions. Kitopi’s kitchens are powered by its proprietary Smart Kitchen Operating System (SKOS), an in-house suite of applications that optimizes cloud kitchen operations in real-time. As part of its growth roadmap, technological innovation, data science, artificial intelligence, and robotics will take center stage as Kitopi continues to reinvent the food industry and remain the leading food company in the region.

With over 6,000 employees, Kitopi currently operates 200+ locations across the UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar. It also operates its Customer Experience Center in Amman, Jordan, and its Engineering Hub in Krakow, Poland.

This is a remote position; however, candidates must be based in India to be eligible for the role.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and scale the pipelines that power our analytics and AI platforms. You will own the full flow from ingestion and preparation to modeling and aggregation in a modern Snowflake-centred stack, with data quality, testing, and ELT best practices built in from day one. You will also help shape how we use AI within data engineering workflows, from pipeline automation to intelligent data produc

What You'll Do
• Design, build, and scale robust ELT pipelines across ingestion, transformation, modeling, and aggregation layers in the warehouse
• Embed data quality checks, testing, and automation into every stage of the pipeline
• Improve and extend existing data products; run POCs for new ones
• Own pipeline monitoring, alerting, and maintenance to keep the platform reliable and performant
• Use AI tooling within DE workflows, including code generation, pipeline automation, and data quality checks
• Contribute to and help shape company-wide data governance standards
• Collaborate with analytics, BI, and business teams to deliver trusted, well-modeled data

What We’re Looking For
• 5–7 years of hands-on data engineering experience
• Proven production data engineering experience at scale
• Strong Python and SQL skills
• Deep analytical warehouse expertise: dimensional modeling, performance tuning, warehouse-native SQL patterns
• Hands-on experience with DWH testing and automation frameworks
• Experience orchestrating pipelines with Airflow and building transformations with dbt.

Recruitment Process and Timeline
First, you apply, and our talent attraction team will review your profile. If your profile matches our requirements, you will receive a link to schedule a meeting with a recruiter at your convenience. This meeting is an opportunity for you to share more about yourself and for us to get to know you better.

If you are shortlisted, you will meet with our hiring managers. Depending on the role and its requirements, you may need to attend 2-3 interview rounds. These rounds could include a case study, role-play, trial assignment, or live coding session, which will be communicated to you in the initial conversation.

Upon successful completion of the interview rounds, your recruiter will contact you to discuss the offer. We aim to complete this process within 2-3 weeks.

So, what does it really mean to work at Kitopi?
We are constantly striving to make Kitopi the best place to work, by empowering you to be the best version of yourself every day. Our company values act as our guiding principles to help ensure that everyone feels safe, included, and like they truly belong.

Kitopi is an equal-opportunity employer. While we currently operate in 6 countries, we are over 70 different nationalities of talented Kitopians. Whether you are a seasoned professional, a recent graduate, or someone looking to return to the workforce after a break, we encourage you to apply. We celebrate rich diverse backgrounds, lifestyles, and cultures and have a 0-tolerance policy towards racism, bigotry, and hate. Please apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat and help us build a company that we are all proud to work for.

Customer-obsessed and tech-enabled, at Kitopi, we are a team of passionate humans who are on a mission together to satisfy the world’s appetite.

b23e5c7709a2d3be.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention. We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.
Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Systems Engineer is a hands-on builder who moves fast, delivers with quality, and uses AI as a force multiplier in day-to-day work. In this role, you will configure, maintain, and continuously improve Airbnb's Atlassian platforms, and you will own end-to-end delivery of defined projects within the Jira Data Center deprecation and transition to Jira Cloud. You will work autonomously on projects that span several components and may not be fully defined, partnering with senior engineers and your manager to shape the details. You will spot where AI and automation can reduce toil and improve reliability for the teams we serve, then build those improvements. You bring solid platform knowledge, sound technical judgment within your domain, and the curiosity to grow toward senior-level scope.

A Typical Day:

  • Administer Jira Cloud Software (JSW), Jira Cloud Service Management (JSM), and associated Atlassian tooling; take ownership of assigned parts of the environment to improve reliability and quality, following established configuration standards and governance
  • Design and implement Jira configurations including custom workflows, issue type hierarchies, permission schemes, notification schemes, screens, and field configurations aligned with Atlassian best practices, contributing independently to designs and seeking senior review where needed
  • Deliver end-to-end migration workstreams within the Jira Data Center to Cloud program, such as migrating a set of projects or a configuration domain, coordinating with stakeholders on cutover readiness
  • Configure Jira Service Management projects including SLAs, custom queues, JSM Forms, approval workflows, and security schemes to support internal service delivery teams
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting using native Jira Cloud tooling; Airbnb has elected to avoid Atlassian Marketplace products for information security, privacy, and legal reasons. Support and maintain Airbnb's custom Forge applications in partnership with supporting systems engineering teams
  • Support Atlassian access management, user lifecycle management, and license hygiene, and contribute to security posture improvements
  • Partner with business stakeholders in requirements-gathering sessions, translate needs into configuration and automation solutions, and proactively highlight issues or risks in the work

Headquarters: Remote

At Expel, we believe if we look after our employees, they will take care of our customers, and the rest will work itself out. It’s as simple as that. We have built a great place to work where our atmosphere is truly transparent, people love what they do, and work gets appreciated. Now we’re scaling a sales culture that is also transparent and customer focused. A place where our customers rave about their sales team. Where they speak of trust, openness, respect and honesty. We want our customers to not only love our product but feel good about how they get treated during every interaction with us.

You ask questions to understand problems and you enjoy being a true partner to tackle them. Your customers walk with you because they know you only sell products you believe in, products you stand behind, aspirin for the headache they actually have. We know that no matter how good a product is, someone has to guide the sales process – and you excel at this.

You haven’t sold just any product, you’ve sold information security products. It’s a tangled, messy market with confusing, overlapping messages and frequently unclear value propositions. We are excited to discuss the product and hope that you share in a genuine opportunity to offer Expel to the world.

Did you nod your head a few times while reading this? If so, we'd love to hear from you. You're our kind of seller.

What Expel can do for you

• We provide an opportunity to solve real business security problems

• We let you tap into a market space ripe for success with our offerings

• We connect you with cloud first companies who truly want to get better at information security and are eager to share their points of view.

• We offer you people and a company who want to deliver an outstanding solution, and to reach the right customers we need to be phenomenal at sales. We're all in it together.

• We'll give you experience in a startup environment with a team who truly cares about doing meaningful work.

• We provide a simple compensation plan that pays you well for closing deals and includes a strong accelerator when you overachieve.

What you can do for Expel

• Understand what Expel does and approach how it maps to your customers' business problems with a consultative mindset.

• Talk to new prospective customers. Begin to build your personal relationship with them as you tell them about Expel. If Expel fits, change them from prospects into customers.

• Qualify prospects based on their interest level in Expel’s cloud solutions and their ability to purchase by virtue of the buyer’s budget, authority, need, and timeline.

• Tell us what you learn as you explore the market. Help us understand where Expel fits, what we are missing, and how can we be better and ultimately, get to “yes” before “no”.

What you should bring with you

• A real passion for Sales Done Right - meaning consultative, customer-focused and based in transparency, honesty and integrity.

• An understanding of information security -- technologies, products and services; specifically cloud first security minded organizations.

• Experience working in a fast-growing, “scale up” environment.

• Comfortable working remotely, and asynchronously (you will be based out of your home office and will need strong prioritization/time management habits)

• Lots of creativity, passion and problem solving towards helping customers.

• An ability to talk to both business and technical buyers about what you’re selling - you don’t have to be an engineer, but you do need to understand what you sell.

• A Bachelor’s degree or a compelling story.

• 3+ years of professional experience, with at least 1 in information security sales.

Additional notes

The targeted compensation range for this role is between: $100,000 USD & $110,000 USD base, $200,000 & $220,000 OTE + equity.

b2f5d6fc24f04c72.description: kAIgentic is building the intelligence layer for the world's most ambitious enterprises. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. You will also be kAIgentics experience lead across the platform. You will set the principles and patterns every product follows, and own the journeys that cross product boundaries. Our users do hard, regulated work: confirming how a bank process really runs, redesigning it, and deciding what to automate. The job is not to make that work look simple.
